description_en: Creates a service-linked role based on the service-linked role name associated with an Alibaba Cloud service
description_zh: 根据产品关联的 SLR名称创建SLR
name: CreateServiceLinkedRoleForProduct

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Alibaba Cloud service or the name of the service-linked role associated with the service. Valid values:
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSendToFC: Performs event delivery to Function Compute.
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSendToSMS: Performs event delivery as text messages to Short Message Service.
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSendToDirectMail: Performs event delivery as emails to Direct Mail.
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSourceRocketMQ: Integrates consumed messages from MSMQ RocketMQ instances into EventBridge.
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSourceMNS: Integrates Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) into EventBridge.
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeConnectVPC: Allows EventBridge to access your VPC.
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSourceActionTrail: Retrieves operation records from ActionTrail as event sources.
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSourceRabbitMQ: Integrates MSMQ RabbitMQ instances into EventBridge.
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSendToRabbitMQ: Performs event delivery of EventBridge events to MSMQ RabbitMQ instances.
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSendToRocketMQ: Performs event delivery of EventBridge events to MSMQ RocketMQ instances.
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSourceCMS: Integrates Alibaba Cloud monitoring (CMS) into EventBridge.
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSendToKafka: Performs event delivery of EventBridge events to Message Queue for Apache Kafka clusters.
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSourceKafka: Integrates Message Queue for Apache Kafka into EventBridge.
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSendToRDS: Performs event delivery of EventBridge events to Relational Database Service (RDS) instances.
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSendToSAE: Performs event delivery of EventBridge events to Serverless App DPI engine (SAE) applications.
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSourceMqtt: Integrates MSMQ MQTT into EventBridge.
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSourceSLS: Integrates Simple Log Service into EventBridge
parameters.help_zh:
云产品名称或者云产品关联的SLR名称。

AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSendToFC：将事件投递到FC服务。
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSendToSMS：将事件作为短信投递到阿里云短信服务。
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSendToDirectMail：将事件作为邮件投递到阿里云邮件服务。
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSourceRocketMQ：将阿里云RocketMQ实例中的消费消息集成到EventBridge。
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSourceMNS：将阿里云消息服务（MNS）集成到EventBridge。
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeConnectVPC：允许EventBridge访问用户VPC网络。
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSourceActionTrail：从阿里云操作审计（ActionTrail）中获取操作记录作为事件源。
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSourceRabbitMQ：将阿里云消息队列RabbitMQ实例集成到EventBridge。
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSendToRabbitMQ：将EventBridge事件投递到阿里云消息队列RabbitMQ实例。
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSendToRocketMQ：将EventBridge事件投递到阿里云消息队列RocketMQ实例。
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSourceCMS：将阿里云云监控（CMS）集成到EventBridge。
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSendToKafka：将EventBridge事件投递到阿里云消息队列Kafka版集群。
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSourceKafka：将阿里云消息队列Kafka版集成到EventBridge。
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSendToRDS：将EventBridge事件投递到阿里云关系型数据库（RDS）实例。
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSendToSAE：将EventBridge事件投递到应用引擎（SAE）应用。
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSourceMqtt：将微消息队列MQTT版集成到EventBridge。
AliyunServiceRoleForEventBridgeSourceSLS：将日志服务SLS集成到EventBridge
parameters.name: product_name

Code.description_en: The return code of the API operation. A value of Success indicates that the request is successful. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see Error codes
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码：Success：表示成功。                                 其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误码

HttpCode.description_en:
The HTTP status code. Valid values:

2xx: 2xx status codes.
3xx: 3xx status codes.
4xx: 4xx status codes.
5xx: 5xx status codes.

If you do not specify this parameter, all the preceding HTTP status codes are queried by default
HttpCode.description_zh:
HTTP状态码。取值：

2xx：2xx状态码。
3xx：3xx状态码。
4xx：4xx状态码。
5xx：5xx状态码。

如果不传该参数，默认查询以上全部HTTP状态码

Message.description_en: The response message. If the request is successful, the value is success
Message.description_zh: 响应消息，若成功请求为success

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation is successful
